text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 25, 2024) for 6 Pinewood Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed Items 1, 2, 3 and 5 on the Property Standards Order (June 25, 2024) for 6 Pinewood Avenue, Folder Number 24 152254 PRS 00 IV, as amended by the Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel on September 23, 2024. 2. Confirmed Item 4 on the Property Standards Order (June 25, 2024) for 6 Pinewood Avenue, Folder Number 24 152254 PRS 00 IV, as amended by the Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel on September 23, 2024, and in so doing granted an extension to September 2, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
